title: dbfbridge WriteResult (JSON-safe tool boundary)
description: Machine-readable contract for dbfbridge.WriteResult.to_dict() (DBFB-MCP-010, DBFB-RESULT-001). The host tool server declares this shape as its output schema instead of serializing __dict__/repr. Paths are POSIX-form strings; fpt_path and fpt_sha256 are null when the write publishes no memo companion; warnings carry limitation text only and never record or memo values.

fpt_path.description: Final published FPT path (POSIX form), or null when no memo companion was published.

structural_cdx.description: True when the schema declared a structural CDX index (presence only; never an index-validity claim).

index_rebuild_required.description: True when the destination must have its index rebuilt externally before use.

dbc_bound.description: True when the schema declared DBC binding; the written table is standalone.

dbf_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the final published DBF (lowercase hex).

fpt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the final published FPT (lowercase hex), or null when none was published.

warnings.description: Human-readable limitation notices (e.g. structural CDX, DBC); never record or memo payload values.
